description: Historical one-off GitHub Action/trigger source retained to allow safe remote branch removal. Not executed from this docs path.

files.source:
name: S2-2A1 exact-source read-only contract tests
on:
  push:
    branches: [automation/verify-s2a1-20261017]
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/s2a1-plan-test-20261017.yml

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  test-case-contract:
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 2
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Check exact PR source and no unexpected trigger changes
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD^)" = "960f02450e84844d41943c66d17039ac2c8f4f2e"
          test "$(git diff --name-only HEAD^ HEAD)" = ".github/workflows/s2a1-plan-test-20261017.yml"
          git checkout --detach 960f02450e84844d41943c66d17039ac2c8f4f2e
          echo "TESTED_SOURCE_SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
      - name: Test read-only contract without G5 or original vendor
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python -m pip install pyyaml==6.0.3
          python -m unittest discover -s native_cpp/orchestration/tests -p 'test_*.py' -v
          python -m native_cpp.orchestration.plan --case-yaml project/cases/hefei5km_2022_reference_case_20261011/case.yaml > /tmp/cteas-s2a1-plan.json
          python - <<'PY'
          import json
          p=json.load(open("/tmp/cteas-s2a1-plan.json"))
          assert p["status"] == "DRY_RUN_ONLY_EXECUTION_BLOCKED",p
          assert not p["ready"] and not p["legacy_fallback"],p
          assert all(not s["execute"] for s in p["stages"]),p
          print("S2A1_DRY_RUN_CONTRACT=PASS_SOFTWARE")
          PY
      - name: Save read-only manifest
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: s2a1-plan-evidence
          path: /tmp/cteas-s2a1-plan.json
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 14

name: S2-2A1 frozen-control exact-SHA read-only tests
on:
  push:
    branches: [automation/verify-s2a1-controls-20261017]
    paths: [.github/workflows/s2a1-plan-contract-followup-20261017.yml]
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  read-only-schema:
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 2
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Require exact PR source and no other workflow-side edits
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD^)" = "756ec8665d78c1eb7335c4cab385c3e174c7388d"
          test "$(git diff --name-only HEAD^ HEAD)" = ".github/workflows/s2a1-plan-contract-followup-20261017.yml"
          git checkout --detach "756ec8665d78c1eb7335c4cab385c3e174c7388d"
          echo "TESTED_SOURCE_SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
      - name: Validate native-only read-only case contract (no G5)
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python -m pip install pyyaml==6.0.3
          python -m unittest discover -s native_cpp/orchestration/tests -p 'test_*.py' -v
          python -m native_cpp.orchestration.plan --case-yaml project/cases/hefei5km_2022_reference_case_20261011/case.yaml > /tmp/s2a1-plan.json
          python - <<'PY'
          import json
          from pathlib import Path
          p=json.loads(Path("/tmp/s2a1-plan.json").read_text())
          assert p["status"]=="DRY_RUN_ONLY_EXECUTION_BLOCKED",p
          assert len(p["stages"])==7,p
          assert not p["ready"] and not p["legacy_fallback"] and all(not s["execute"] for s in p["stages"]),p
          print("S2A1_STRICT_FROZEN_CASE_DRY_RUN=PASS_SOFTWARE")
          PY
